model_claims.text: The library raises ReadTimeoutError (or urllib3.exceptions.TimeoutError) when a socket timeout occurs while sending the request body, instead of wrapping it as ProtocolError.
model_claims.source_quote: Raise ReadTimeoutError for timeouts while sending the request body

model_claims.text: After the change, _make_request maps SocketTimeout through _raise_timeout() and urlopen no longer treats leftover socket.timeout instances as aborted connections, causing send timeouts to be reported as timeout errors.
model_claims.source_quote: This converts send timeouts the same way as read timeouts: `_make_request` maps `SocketTimeout` through `_raise_timeout()`, and `urlopen` no longer treats leftover `socket.timeout` instances as aborted connections.
